description: Kern County Veterans Service is a local point of contact for veterans seeking help with benefits and service questions. Contact the department to arrange an appointment.
introduction: Kern County Veterans Service is a local point of contact for veterans seeking help with benefits and service questions. Contact the department to arrange an appointment.

who: Veterans across Kern County can contact the department. Eligibility for a particular VA or other benefit is determined by that benefit’s rules.
sections.get: The office can be contacted for veteran service inquiries. Ask whether your issue requires claim assistance, a referral or contact with the agency administering the benefit.
sections.docs: When booking, ask what service records, decision notices or other documents to bring. Make a short list of questions and explain any claim deadline before the appointment.
sections.apply: Call 661-868-7300 or email kernvets@kerncounty.com. The current contact page lists appointments at 1120 Golden State Avenue, Bakersfield.
sections.after: Keep copies of any paperwork submitted and confirm which agency will respond. Ask how to track a claim and who to contact if a notice arrives before the next appointment.
sections.sources:
• Kern County Veterans Service contacts
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Should I arrive without an appointment?
The current contact page describes visits by appointment; contact the office first.
Does contacting the county guarantee VA approval?
No. The benefit agency makes its own decision.
1120 Golden State Avenue, according to the current department contact page.
Ask staff for the checklist for your particular issue when scheduling.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
